description: This file defines the BinaryOps class for handling binary data type operations in pandas-on-Spark, including methods for addition, comparison, and type casting of binary data.

classes.name: BinaryOps
classes.description: Class for binary operations on pandas-on-Spark objects with BinaryType.

methods.name: pretty_name
methods.description: Property returning the name 'binaries' for display purposes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Concatenates binary data with support for IndexOpsMixin and bytes.

methods.name: radd
methods.description: Concatenates binary data in reverse order with support for bytes.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Performs less-than comparison on binary data.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Performs less-than-or-equal comparison on binary data.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Performs greater-than-or-equal comparison on binary data.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Performs greater-than comparison on binary data.

methods.name: astype
methods.description: Casts binary data to specified data types, handling categorical, boolean, string, and other types.
